column2: Pretorius's Proposed Western Frontier

A Republican Bechuanaland Demand

South African envoys invoke the disputed frontier proposed in 1868 and ask us to conclude a district convention. Their victory over Britain gives the demand new weight, but a republican map cannot extinguish our authority or the rights of our communities. The council can offer a handover, seek compensation and guarantees, or retain the districts under our government.
The Frontier Council's Reply
The delegation has brought the council's answer. An offered convention can be ratified
column3: negotiated articles require provision for compensation and local rights. A refusal leaves the raad to reopen the talks, withdraw its demand or authorise a campaign. Any handover concerns only the named districts still governed by this council. The existing rights of neighbours and frontier communities remain matters for their own agreements.

column2: Commandos on the Bechuanaland Frontier

The declaration has reached the opposing government. The campaign seeks the districts named in the frontier register, and occupation must make that demand enforceable. Commandants must distinguish the opponent's districts from neighbouring territory. A convention can be imposed once our forces hold all the claimed districts still under that government
column3: other possessions lie beyond the settlement.

column2: Conclude the Occupied Frontier Convention

Our forces hold the claimed districts still governed by the campaign's opponent. Commissioners can impose the district convention and end the fighting. The settlement transfers those occupied districts and leaves the opponent's other possessions outside its articles.
The Frontier Peace Is Accepted

The opposing government has accepted the Bechuanaland frontier articles in the peace settlement. Commissioners receive the named districts still governed by that country and enter their communities, water routes and local rights in the new district registers. Territory held by neighbours and the defeated government's other possessions remains outside this convention.

The mission's counterpart or the conditions of its mandate have changed. The ministry recalls its delegation and closes the outstanding proceedings. No new holder inherits an earlier council's reply. A future approach must be addressed to the government then holding the districts.
